describesHead.landingTitle: fix(ci): retry marketplace extension installs in the VS Code E2E (#798)

implementer.note: ENC0T turns each case into a compile_fail doctest or a table-driven test row. Cases marked boundaryOwner are specified here for the boundary owner's own corpus (ENCL0 subblock 5, ENCF0 subblock 6, EMB0I) and are not ENC0T acceptance.

errorVocabulary.InvalidBoundary: The offset or range is outside the domain's extent, or a range is inverted. Never normalised.
errorVocabulary.Overflow: Checked arithmetic left the integer width (overflow or underflow). Never saturated or wrapped.
errorVocabulary.NotCharBoundary: The offset lands inside a UTF-8 sequence, or a requester offset lands inside a surrogate pair. Never snapped to the nearest boundary.

rules.noClamp: Every failure below is a typed error. No case is satisfied by clamping, saturating, snapping to a character start or to the nearest token.
rules.wireDefined: A behaviour a wire contract itself defines (LSP 3.17 character past line length) is applied only by the boundary adapter, for read-only queries, and is recorded as that wire's rule. Internal arithmetic never inherits it.

cases.case: Adding, subtracting or comparing a SourceByteOffset with a GeneratedByteOffset or EmbeddedByteOffset
cases.expected: does not compile

cases.case: Passing a SourceByteOffset/Range where a GeneratedByteOffset/Range or EmbeddedByteOffset/Range is expected, and every other cross-domain pair
cases.expected: does not compile

cases.case: Implicit conversion from u32/usize (From, Into, Deref, Add<u32>, `as`-style coercion) into any domain type
cases.expected: does not compile; only the explicit named constructor accepts a raw integer

cases.case: offset + length where the sum exceeds u32::MAX
cases.expected: Overflow

cases.case: Rebasing an offset below its base (offset - base with base > offset)
cases.expected: Overflow

cases.case: Constructing a range with end < start
cases.expected: InvalidBoundary; the range is not swapped or emptied

cases.case: Empty range start == end, including at offset 0 and at end-of-file
cases.expected: valid; len() == 0 without saturating subtraction

cases.case: Relative-to-absolute rebase whose base + offset exceeds u32::MAX
cases.expected: Overflow

cases.case: Offset equal to the content length (end-of-file)
cases.expected: valid

cases.case: Offset greater than the content length
cases.expected: InvalidBoundary; not clamped to end-of-file

cases.case: Offset inside a 2-byte (U+00E9), 3-byte (U+2014) and 4-byte (U+1F600) UTF-8 sequence
cases.expected: NotCharBoundary for each interior byte; not snapped to the sequence start

cases.case: Empty content
cases.expected: offset 0 valid; offset 1 InvalidBoundary

cases.case: "a\r\nb": \r\n is one terminator
cases.expected: LSP and TypeScript rules both put b on line 1, column 0

cases.case: Byte offset between \r and \n of a \r\n pair converted to line/column
cases.expected: a valid byte offset in the source domain, but it lies inside a two-byte terminator and has no line/column position: conversion to a line/column form returns InvalidBoundary instead of reporting a column past the line end or a position on the next line

cases.case: Lone \r ("a\rb")
cases.expected: LSP 3.17 and TypeScript rules both start a new line after \r; b is line 1, column 0
cases.note: LI1 (verter_type_runtime::codec) breaks only at \n at the described head

cases.case: U+2028 and U+2029 in the content
cases.expected: TypeScript rule: a new line starts after each; LSP 3.17 rule: no new line. The same byte offset converts to different line/column pairs under the two rules, and converting between the two forms goes through the byte offset, never line/column directly

cases.case: Content ending with a terminator
cases.expected: line count = terminators + 1; (last line, 0) is valid and equals end-of-file

cases.case: One file mixing \n, \r\n and lone \r
cases.expected: each terminator counted once by its rule; round trip byte -> line/column -> byte is exact for every scalar boundary

cases.case: Astral scalar U+1F600 before the position
cases.expected: UTF-8 width 4, UTF-16 width 2, UTF-32 width 1; round trips exact in all three

cases.case: Requester UTF-16 offset or column landing between the two units of a surrogate pair
cases.expected: NotCharBoundary at ingress for edits and checked paths
cases.note: The accepted TypeScript wire index (LI2) resolves an in-pair offset to the pair start by design; ENCT0 verifies that behaviour instead of migrating it

cases.case: Combining sequence e + U+0301
cases.expected: the offset between base and mark is a valid scalar boundary; columns count code units, not graphemes

cases.case: ZWJ sequence (U+1F468 U+200D U+1F469 U+200D U+1F467)
cases.expected: every scalar boundary valid; widths are the sum of the scalars' widths per encoding

cases.case: Leading byte-order mark U+FEFF
cases.expected: counted as content (3 bytes, 1 UTF-16 unit) in every domain; a layer that strips it re-bases through a declared offset, never silently

cases.case: Generated source containing non-ASCII authored identifiers and string literals
cases.expected: byte and UTF-16 positions differ and both convert exactly; no ASCII assumption

cases.case: A lone surrogate arriving from a JavaScript string (NAPI/WASM text, cooked template literal)
cases.expected: has no UTF-8 position; ingress returns a typed failure (for cooked literals, EMB0's NonUnicodeCookedLiteral partiality) before any offset is minted

cases.case: size_of and align_of every offset newtype versus u32, and every range versus two u32
cases.expected: equal; types are #[repr(transparent)] over the existing width

cases.case: A UTF-8-negotiated LSP session handling a position request
cases.expected: allocates no conversion buffer (UAK0 Z05)

cases.case: ASCII fast path versus the general path on the same input
cases.expected: identical results on every offset of an ASCII and a non-ASCII corpus; the fast path is a differential, not an assumption
